title: Engagement page: send inquiries to Prospectus instead of the Google Form
description:
Ryan, 2026-10-17 portfolio review: the anth.us contact path is a Google Form, which undercuts the Prospectus pitch. The engage page gets an inline inquiry form that posts to Prospectus intake (Prospectus kanbus-47dc15ae). The form appears only when GATSBY_PROSPECTUS_INTAKE_URL is set for the build; until then the page keeps the Google Form link, so nothing changes in production before Prospectus real-contact intake is deployed.

Feature: Engagement inquiries reach Prospectus
  Scenario: Intake configured
    Given GATSBY_PROSPECTUS_INTAKE_URL points at Prospectus intake
    When a visitor sends the engage form
    Then they see a receipt and the inquiry lands in Prospectus
  Scenario: Intake not configured
    Given no intake URL
    Then the page keeps the existing contact link
